omar (AE): Heads up 5: enterprise prospect (lending) requested a detailed answer on key rotation SLAs and whether Redwood can perform key zeroization on demand for compliance auditors. They asked for sample language for contract.

claire (sales-eng): TL;DR: Redwood does not zeroize customer key material for BYOK when keys remain in customer HSM; we can coordinate zeroization steps and record the operations. If keys are imported into our environment (customer-consented import) we can zeroize key material on request but will need signed authorization and will follow our service ops runbook.

rachel (security): For contract language we usually suggest: 
"Customer retains control of cryptographic key material. For BYOK where keys are maintained within the Customers HSM, Redwood stores only ciphertext and key references and will not access, export, or otherwise handle unencrypted key material. Upon written request by Customer, Redwood will coordinate and verify zeroization steps and provide signed attestation of completed operations if keys were previously imported with Customer authorization."

diego (solutions): POC timeline: 10 business days if it's CloudHSM + KMS import. If it's on-prem HSM with mutual-TLS gateway expect 3 weeks because of cert exchange and network windows.

claire (sales-eng): Pricing addendum: contract-level BYOK support fee (one-time) + per-HSM connector monthly. Sample ballpark: $15k onboarding + $1k/mo/connector. Zeroization attestation is an add-on service (one-time $2k) because of manual ops and audit packaging.

omar (AE): They also want a short proof snippet showing we never see plaintext when encrypt-only mode is used. Can someone paste the sample code we provide?

claire (sales-eng): sample snippet: 
```
# client-side envelope encryption example
symmetric_key = generate_data_key() # generated inside customer HSM
ciphertext = redwood.encrypt(payload, key_ref=symmetric_key.ciphertext_blob)
# Redwood receives only ciphertext. Decrypt requires call to customer's KMS.
```

rachel (security): Also add in questionnaire response: "Can customers require us to destroy keys?" -> "If keys are customer-managed and never imported, Redwood cannot destroy them; we can coordinate and provide attestation once customer completes the zeroization. If keys were imported into our environment under customer authorization, we will perform zeroization upon verified request following documented procedures."

sales-bot: Ticket created: POC-5012 BYOK zeroization & rotation SLA. Owner: diego (solutions).

omar (AE): Thanks. I'll send the sample clause and the snippet to their legal and ops teams and get back with expected tx/sec. :ok_hand:
